title: introduce-sessionized-token-heatmaps-and-adaptive-alert-calibration
author: Priya Nair
description: Problem: token-level telemetry and alerting often reacts to short-lived bursts (for example long-prefix generations or SDK retries) which inflates alert noise and makes SLOs brittle. We need better context-aware aggregates so we can 1) understand where cost/latency is concentrated within a session and 2) tune alert thresholds that adapt to per-session characteristics. Proposal: add sessionized token heatmaps and an adaptive alert calibration step that uses per-session histograms to reduce false positives. This PR implements: a lightweight sessionization layer in the ingest pipeline (session keys derived from request_id + user_id heuristic), an in-memory histogram rollup (per session) sampled with reservoir sampling, a new heatmap rollup index keyed by route+model+session-window, dashboard tiles for the Console, and a new alert calibration controller that adjusts percentile thresholds based on observed session variance. Backwards compatibility: raw token metrics remain unchanged and the sessionized index is optional (config flag true by default for hosted). Rollout: gated behind feature flag feature.observability.sessionized_heatmaps; staged rollout across regions with a canary at 1% traffic then 25% then full. Testing: unit tests for sessionization and histogram sketch, integration tests with synthetic traces, bench tests for ingress throughput (10k rps sustained). Checklist: [x] design doc linked (ENG-9123), [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] console tiles and README, [x] docs page describing calibration algorithm, [x] release notes entry. Impact: reduces alert noise for token-tail SLOs by up to 45% in internal canary; <6% additional CPU overhead on delivery nodes at 2000 concurrent sessions.

review_comments: Ethan Zhang: Please add a short description of how session keys are derived and why user_id+request_id was chosen. Concerned about cross-tenant collision with proxied requests.
Priya Nair: Reply: added section in docs and improved key derivation to include tenant_id if present; clarified collision risk and TTL semantics (30s window by default).
Maya Chopra: The reservoir sketch looks good but add a bounded memory guard on the writer side to avoid OOM under unhealthy traffic patterns.
Priya Nair: Reply: added writer-side circuit breaker and instrumentation for memory usage; updated unit tests to simulate high-cardinality streams.
Diego Morales: Can we expose a metric showing how many sessions contributed to a heatmap tile? That will help dashboards show coverage.
Priya Nair: Reply: added observability metric heatmap.session_count and included it on the dashboard tile; also added examples in docs.
release_notes: Adds optional sessionized token heatmaps and an adaptive alert calibration controller to reduce token-tail SLO noise. New dashboard tiles and tuning knobs in the Console. Feature is behind a feature flag and non-breaking for existing telemetry consumers.
